verdict.rationale: Delaware's machine channel is 1099 XML file submission through the Taxpayer Portal. Delaware documents that it follows the IRS schema formats published on the IRS IRIS website, so a machine-readable XML schema exists for that channel by reference, but Delaware publishes no schema of its own and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a Delaware-published schema or data dictionary covering state-specific fields, any spec beyond the 1099 XML upload (e.g. W2, withholding or gross receipts), an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the IRS IRIS schemas validate against the Delaware portal.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary

citations.quote: Only the 1099 XML file format will be accepted via the DE Taxpayer Portal.
Division of Revenue will follow the same schema formats as the IRS, available on the IRS IRIS website.
